requirements.title: Catalog and product pages
requirements.next: Maintain exact SKU, size, image and price mapping; no inferred stock.
requirements.done_when: All 84 variants resolve correctly on desktop/mobile and server prices match the catalog.

requirements.title: Persistent customer requests
requirements.next: Use the operations inbox for contact, bulk, partner and update requests; verify real notification delivery.
requirements.done_when: Saved request survives email failure; duplicate submit creates one record; staff can assign, update and audit it.

requirements.title: Approved replacement merchant account
requirements.next: Complete the existing processor review for the exact catalog, Canadian entity, settlement bank and countries. Obtain written account scope, fees and NMI sandbox/live access. An inquiry or API key is not approval.
requirements.done_when: Executed agreement and written catalog acceptance; no unsupported payment-method logos.

requirements.title: Native checkout and reconciliation
requirements.next: NMI Component/v5 and PayerURL adapters are deployed. Complete account-specific sandbox/callback/refund tests, configure protected credentials and register an approved route in /admin-gateways.html. See docs/payment-activation-next-steps.md.
requirements.done_when: Approved account scope and real provider tests pass; an owner-authorized live payment, notification, refund and settlement reconcile exactly once.

requirements.title: Supplier and fulfillment terms
requirements.next: Keep fulfillment manual. Confirm actual availability, cost, origin, delivery, returns and recall contact per accepted order; record supplier acknowledgment and tracking. A supplier API is not required.
requirements.done_when: Signed fulfillment terms and a tested submission/acknowledgment/tracking cycle for an approved order.

requirements.title: Verified supply and lot traceability
requirements.next: No real lots are loaded. Confirm available quantity before issuing an invoice and retain the actual fulfilled lot. Automated cart reservation remains future work; do not advertise inferred stock.
requirements.done_when: Every accepted order has verified available supply and a traceable fulfilled lot; concurrent commitments cannot exceed confirmed supply.

requirements.title: Lot-specific COAs and recalls
requirements.next: Obtain authentic reports, independent verification, reviewer attribution, publish/revoke synchronization and order-lot mapping.
requirements.done_when: An order identifies its exact lot and authentic report; withdrawal removes public eligibility and identifies affected orders.

requirements.title: Rates and eligible destinations
requirements.next: Keep owner-reviewed delivery and destination eligibility before invoicing. Instant cart checkout needs confirmed origin, service/rate rules, packaging limits and tax/duties handling.
requirements.done_when: Every accepted cart receives a valid route and shipping charge before payment; no worldwide default.

requirements.title: Tax, accounting and legal entity
requirements.next: Confirm seller of record, bank settlement identity, registrations, invoice fields, collection/remittance rules, bookkeeping and currency policy.
requirements.done_when: Representative orders/refunds reconcile to processor payouts and tax reports using confirmed obligations.

requirements.title: Prepaid annual memberships
requirements.next: VIP US$49 / Elite US$99 nonrenewing 365-day passes and verified receipt/refund entitlements are implemented. Obtain provider approval for passes separately from goods and verify one real paid/refunded pass.
requirements.done_when: Approved pass payment grants access once; full refund revokes it; expiry is enforced. No automatic renewal is offered.

requirements.title: Recurring product subscriptions
requirements.next: Recurring product billing is not offered. A research planning list is not a subscription. Introduce it only after explicit terms, provider support and verified stock/cancellation handling.
requirements.done_when: Each paid cycle creates one order and reservation; pause/skip/cancel and failed-payment recovery are tested.

requirements.title: Points, credit and gift cards
requirements.next: No launch points, cashback, gift-card balances or spendable store credit are offered. Keep these disabled unless approved terms and tested transactional ledgers are introduced.
requirements.done_when: Duplicate events cannot double-award; simultaneous redemption cannot overspend; refunds reverse correctly.

requirements.title: Membership and volume discounts
requirements.next: Server-side pricing applies the highest single eligible member/volume discount per line. Preserve the published launch terms; additional coupons, BOGO and free gifts are not offered.
requirements.done_when: Authoritative invoice totals and refund behavior match published discount terms; discounts never stack or alter shipping/taxes/pass fees.

requirements.title: Affiliates and partner payouts
requirements.next: Partner inquiries are durable requests. No commission or payout program is promised. Financial attribution and payout ledgers require separately approved terms before activation.
requirements.done_when: An eligible order accrues once, refunds reverse once, and an approved payout reconciles to its ledger.

requirements.title: Transactional and marketing messaging
requirements.next: Invoice notification outbox and signed scheduled retry worker are deployed. Verify real sender/inbox delivery and failures; bounce/complaint suppression and consent are required before any marketing campaign.
requirements.done_when: Requests persist before sending; failed sends are recoverable; consent evidence and suppression apply to every campaign.

requirements.title: Support, refunds and privacy requests
requirements.next: Use assigned request states and audit notes. Full NMI refunds are implemented; verify actual account behavior. Partial refunds, disputes, returns and privacy requests require documented manual handling.
requirements.done_when: Each case has an accountable resolution; refunds and privacy operations are verified and recorded.

requirements.title: Search visibility and accessibility
requirements.next: Publish unique product metadata, canonical URLs, sitemap, robots rules and explicit public build output; verify indexing separately.
requirements.done_when: Crawlable product pages, no backend files in static output, accessible keyboard/mobile paths; search indexing is checked after submission.

requirements.title: Observability, backups and launch acceptance
requirements.next: Confirm commercial hosting, actual provider reconciliation and alert ownership; restore-test backups and verify payment through manual supplier delivery/refund. Do not mark full operation from CI alone.
requirements.done_when: Payment-to-delivery/refund works end to end, backups restore, and failed workflows produce actionable alerts.
